## Hotel Brands Commonly Considered for Upper-Upscale Conversions in Europe

Conversions have become a dominant growth strategy in European hospitality. 
Conversions represented around 84% of openings and 71% of signings in Europe in 2025.
 
The European hotel market is undergoing rapid franchise adoption, with brand affiliation rising from ~33% a decade ago to ~41% in 2022 — still far below the US at approximately 70%.
 Below are the main brands grouped by parent company that owners typically evaluate:

### 🔵 IHG Hotels & Resorts

IHG has been one of the most active players in European conversions. 
In 2024, conversions to IHG brands represented more than 80% of new openings in Europe.
